observation.command:
for u in \
 "https://urbo-maven.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/releases/" \
 "https://urbo-maven.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/releases/io/" \
 "https://urbo-maven.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/releases/io/swcode/urbo/build/logic/root-project/" \
 "https://urbo-maven.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/releases/io/swcode/urbo/build/logic/root-project/1.0.56/root-project-1.0.56.pom" \
 "https://urbo-maven.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/releases/io/swcode/urbo/build/logic/root-project/root-project.gradle.plugin/maven-metadata.xml" ; do
 code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 20 "$u"); echo "$code $u"; done
